sub_agendas_items.title: PWIC-2026-05 - Vehicle Characteristics and Collision Severity Data
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Submitted by Councillor S. Devine
Background:
Traffic Services receives data on collisions that occur within the City of Ottawa from the Ministry of Transportation (MTO) on a continual basis. Collision data is provided to the MTO by policing agencies, including the Ottawa Police Service, the Ontario Provincial Police and The Royal Canadian Mounted Police at varying intervals.
Emerging research indicates a correlation between vehicle characteristics such as size, weight, and geometry, and the severity of collisions involving vulnerable road users, particularly in fatal and major injuries (FMI). To support evidence-based policy development, through the next iteration of Ottawa’s Road Safety Action Plan, it is important to assess how the data presently available to the City can support a more detailed review of collisions by vehicle characteristics and if there are opportunities to enhance that data over time.
